Hello,
I can currently see three artifacts in the War Hall showcase that have not been sold before: Cyrus Cylinder, South Governor Compass, and Leftwich Trophy.
When are you planning to make these artifacts available for sale?
There used to be events or draws where we had a chance to earn Legendary Tokens. It has been a long time since you last ran something like this.
Are you planning to bring this type of event back?
In the Manufactury, offensive accounts have a big advantage. Since they use fewer troop types, they can complete and max their munitions much faster.
For defensive accounts, however, this feels like an endless grind. It would take me around 3 years of continuous work to complete everything.
Are you planning to make any improvements or changes to help speed up progression for defensive players?
Do you have any plans to increase the “luck” aspect of the game based on VIP level?
Some of my friends have spent a significant amount of money on the game, yet their luck seems to be no different from players who haven’t spent anything. This doesn’t feel very fair.
What are your thoughts on this?
I have some valuable Stronghold troops that I am not using. I would like to be able to exchange them for Legendary Tokens.
Would it be possible to add a feature like this through Marco Polo?

이 상의 이름은 베트남전에서 사망한 중령 윌리엄 G. 레프트위치 주니어의 이름을 따서 붙여졌습니다. 그는 1965년 호아 아잉 전투에서 영웅적 행위로 해군 수훈장과 퍼플 하트 메달을 수여 받았습니다. 그의 두 번째 임무는 1970년 4월에 시작되었는데 그는 모든 비상 탈출 미션에 직접 참여하겠다고 주장했습니다. 그는 해당 미션을 수행하다가 동일한 해 11월 18일 헬리콥터 사고로 사망했습니다.The Leftwich Trophy is a U.S. Marine Corps award given annually since 1979 for outstanding leadership. The recipient must be a marine captain serving with the ground forces of the Fleet Marine Force. The commanding generals of the Marine Corps of the Atlantic and the Pacific each put forth three candidates, from which one recipient is chosen.

The award is named after Lt. Col. William G. Leftwich Jr. who served as an officer during the Vietnam War. In 1965, he was awarded a Navy Cross and Purple Heart for his heroism during the Battle of Hoai An. He began his second tour of duty in April 1970, making a point to personally accompany every emergency extraction mission. It was during one of these missions that he was killed in a helicopter crash on November 18th that same year.                                        5. 기타[편집]                                        #1 #2
